metadata.scope: Country-by-team English Wikipedia categories associated with European domestic, regional and continental basketball leagues.
metadata.ratingExplanation: Head-coach honors receive full competition-specific value. Assistant, consultant and youth honors receive reduced value. Player achievements remain in the database but receive zero coaching points. Experience is added and raw scores are percentile-ranked across the scraped European pool. The 99th percentile and above is capped at 90.

biography.introduction: Ferried Naciri (born 12 February 1989) is a Belgian basketball coach. He has been an assistant and head coach for several clubs in Belgium, Denmark and the Netherlands. He is currently an assistant coach for Löwen Braunschweig of the German Basketball Bundesliga (BBL).

sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Romania by team
Category:Basketball coaches in France by team

biography.introduction: Mihai Nedef (November 8, 1931 – 10 June 2017) was a Romanian basketball player who competed in the 1952 Summer Olympics. He was born in Bucharest. He was part of the Romanian basketball team, which was eliminated in the first round of the 1952 tournament. He played both matches. He died on 10 June 2017.
